rule.deleteByWord.title: Delete by word, not by letter
rule.deleteByWord.body: You deleted a word one backspace at a time. Ctrl+Backspace removes a whole word at once; Ctrl+Delete removes the word after the cursor. Fixing a typo goes from five taps to one.
rule.hopByWord.title: Jump by word, not by letter
rule.hopByWord.body: Long runs of ← and → usually mean crossing a sentence to reach a typo. Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→ hop a word at a time. Your cursor arrives before your patience does.
rule.selectByWord.title: Select by word
rule.selectByWord.body: Crawling across text with Shift+arrow selects one character at a time. Hold Ctrl too and each step grabs a whole word; Shift+End selects to the end of the line in one stroke.
rule.docStartEnd.title: Reach the top and bottom of a document
rule.docStartEnd.body: That long run of ↑ and ↓ has a shortcut: Ctrl+Home jumps to the very beginning, Ctrl+End to the very end. Scrolling is for reading; jumping is for going.
rule.lineStartEnd.title: Use Home and End instead of crawling
rule.lineStartEnd.body: Long runs of ← and → usually end at the start or end of a line. On Windows, Home and End go straight there, and Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End cover the whole document.
rule.virtualDesktops.title: Switch desktops from the keyboard
rule.virtualDesktops.body: You work across several apps every day. Win+Ctrl+← / Win+Ctrl+→ move between virtual desktops; create one per project and stop hunting for windows.
rule.virtualDesktops.summary: {0} days of multi-app work, Win+Ctrl+← never used
rule.appSwitching.title: Switch apps without the mouse
rule.appSwitching.body: You changed apps again and again today, and almost none of that was Alt+Tab. Hold Alt and tap Tab to cycle open apps; keep Alt held and press Tab again for the next one.
rule.tabSwitching.title: Switch browser tabs from the keyboard
rule.tabSwitching.body: You've been using a browser for days without Ctrl+Tab — the shortcut that moves to the next tab in every browser. Ctrl+Shift+Tab goes back one. Your mouse can stay where it is.
rule.tabSwitching.summary: {0} days of browsing, Ctrl+Tab never used
